title: Design System: Matteo Palermo — Il Manuale

display.purpose: The 'MATTEO PALERMO' cobalt wordmark on the cover — the documented specimen. Appears once.

headline.purpose: Numbered section headings 01-04, with the mono number as left-margin marginalia.

title.purpose: Project titles and Competenze group names inside sections.

lead.purpose: The opening paragraph of a section; max ~58ch.

body.purpose: Running prose; max 46-58ch, ink at 90% or muted.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase sans labels for document classification, the 'Indice' tag, and the email-block kicker. Never a decorative headline eyebrow.

mono.purpose: Geist Mono for measurable data only: spec-list keys/values, plate captions, section numbers, level chips, the revision line, the footer email.

motion.name: wordmark-in
motion.value: 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; per-letter delay calc(var(--i) * 26ms); from { opacity:0; transform: translateY(0.24em); filter: blur(6px) }
motion.purpose: The single authored moment: the wordmark composes letter by letter, once, on load. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-colors
motion.purpose: The only interactive motion: hover/active fill and text inversions on the email block, social icons, and index chips.

grid.note: GridOverlay renders fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none z-0; column right-borders in Grid Line colour; content sits at z-10.

components.name: Index Rail
components.description: Sticky top table-of-contents. Chips 01-04 are real #id anchors; active = solid cobalt block, inactive = hairline outline. Scroll-spy defaults to entry 1 so a filled tab always shows.
components.html: Indice01Profilo02Competenze03Lavori04Contatto
components.css: .ds-index { position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 40; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4rem); background: var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #16150f); } .ds-index__tag { font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--color-graphite, #6b675c); } .ds-index__chip { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, rgba(107,103,92,0.38)); border-radius: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #16150f); transition: border-color 300ms ease, background-color 300ms ease, color 300ms ease; } .ds-index__chip:hover { border-color: var(--color-muted, #5a574e); } .ds-index__chip--on { background: var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); border-color: var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); color: var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea); } .ds-index__chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-index__n { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: 0.06em; } .ds-index__label { font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: The documented specimen: 'MATTEO PALERMO' as two stacked words, cobalt, composing letter by letter once on load.
components.html: MATTEOPALERMO
components.css: .ds-wordmark { font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); font-size: clamp(2.7rem, 13.5vw, 12rem); line-height: 0.92; letter-spacing: -0.04em; padding-bottom: 0.06em; margin: 0; } .ds-wordmark__word { display: block; } .ds-wordmark__l { display: inline-block; animation: ds-wordmark-in 0.72s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(var(--i, 0) * 26ms); } @keyframes ds-wordmark-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(0.24em); filter: blur(6px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; filter: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-wordmark__l { animation: none; } }

components.name: Section Header
components.description: A numbered section: 2px solid cobalt top rule (1px dashed hairline-strong when the content is a curated empty state), headline, and mono section number as left-margin marginalia.
components.css: .ds-section__rule { border-top: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); padding-top: 2.5rem; } .ds-section__rule--broken { border-top: 1px dashed var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-section__h { position: relative; margin: 0; padding: 0 0.75rem; font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; line-height: 1.02; color: var(--color-ink, #16150f); font-size: clamp(1.9rem, 4.6vw, 3.15rem); } .ds-section__n { margin-right: 0.75rem; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.42em; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: var(--color-graphite, #6b675c); } @media (min-width: 1024px) { .ds-section__n { position: absolute; right: 100%; margin-right: 0; padding-right: 1.5rem; } } .ds-section__body { margin-top: 2.5rem; padding: 0 0.75rem 6rem; }

components.name: Spec List
components.description: A technical title-block: mono key/value rows with hairline dividers. Used for cover metadata, profile facts, contact facts, and empty-state status.
components.html:
Documento
Portfolio / manuale

components.css: .ds-spec { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; line-height: 1.625; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--color-muted, #5a574e); } .ds-spec__row { display: flex; gap: 1.25rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.125rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, rgba(107,103,92,0.38)); } .ds-spec__row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-spec__k { width: 6rem; flex-shrink: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-graphite, #6b675c); } .ds-spec__v { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; padding-right: 0.25rem; color: var(--color-ink, #16150f); }

components.name: Plate Frame
components.description: A framed image slot with corner crop-marks and a mono caption. Solid ink border normally; dashed hairline-strong when reserved (slot awaiting real content).
components.css: .ds-plate__box { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-ink, #16150f); aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; } .ds-plate__box--reserved { border: 1px dashed var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-plate__fill { display: flex; height: 100%; width: 100%; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-graphite, #6b675c) 5%, var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea)); } .ds-plate__word { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--color-muted, #5a574e); } .ds-plate__tick { position: absolute; height: 0.75rem; width: 0.75rem; pointer-events: none; } .ds-plate__tick--tl { left: 0; top: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-plate__tick--tr { right: 0; top: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-plate__tick--bl { left: 0; bottom: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-plate__tick--br { right: 0; bottom: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong, rgba(107,103,92,0.58)); } .ds-plate__cap { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-muted, #5a574e); }

components.name: Social Icon
components.description: 36px hairline-bordered square holding an authored stroke/fill SVG. Hover inverts to ink fill / paper icon.
components.css: .ds-social { display: flex; width: 36px; height: 36px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline, rgba(107,103,92,0.38)); border-radius: 0; color: var(--color-ink, #16150f); transition: background-color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-social:hover { background: var(--color-ink, #16150f); border-color: var(--color-ink, #16150f); color: var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea); } .ds-social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Email Block
components.description: The one live element and only primary action. Filled cobalt with paper text; hover inverts the whole block to paper background / cobalt text and nudges the arrow.
components.html: Scrivimimatteo.kay07@gmail.com
components.css: .ds-email { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); color: var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea); transition: background-color 200ms ease, color 200ms ease; } .ds-email:hover { background: var(--color-paper, #f5f2ea); color: var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-cobalt, #1b2be0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-email__kicker { font-family: 'Familjen Grotesk', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.12em; font-size: 0.68rem; } .ds-email__addr { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-size: 0.82rem; } .ds-email__arrow { display: inline-block; width: 0.9em; height: 0.9em; margin-left: 0.5rem; transform: translateY(0.06em); transition: transform 200ms ease; } .ds-email:hover .ds-email__arrow { transform: translate(0.25rem, 0.06em); }

components.name: Grid Overlay
components.description: The always-visible 12-column grid (4 on mobile), fixed behind content, aligned to the same .manual-shell container as the content.
components.css: .ds-grid { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 0; pointer-events: none; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); width: 100%; max-width: 84rem; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: clamp(1.25rem, 5vw, 4rem); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr); } } .ds-grid > span { height: 100%; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-grid, rgba(107,103,92,0.55)); } .ds-grid > span:first-child { border-left: 1px solid var(--color-grid, rgba(107,103,92,0.55)); } .ds-grid > span:nth-child(n+5) { display: none; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-grid > span:nth-child(n+5) { display: block; } }

narrative.overview: The portfolio is not a page, it is a document: a Swiss typographic identity manual whose documented subject is the person. It refuses the dark hero and the card grid outright. The visitor's name is set once as an oversized cobalt wordmark — the specimen on the cover — and the rest of the site is title-blocks, numbered sections (01-04), spec lists, and framed plates, printed on warm paper. The 12-column grid is not a layout aid hidden in dev tools; it is drawn on every screen as load-bearing furniture, the way a manual shows its own construction lines. The palette is disciplined to the point of austerity: warm paper, near-black ink, two warm greys, and exactly one chromatic colour — a single committed cobalt (#1B2BE0) that carries roughly a fifth of any screen and never more. Cobalt marks three things and nothing else: the wordmark, the load-bearing section rules, and the one live action (the email block). Everything is flat. There are no shadows, no gradients, no rounded corners, no cards. Depth is made only of lines. The one moment of motion is the wordmark composing itself letter by letter on load, once, then never again. The tone is precise, unpretentious, and Italian: this is one identifiable maker's calling card, and the manual conceit is the personality.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper (#F5F2EA) and ink (#16150F), one committed cobalt, two warm greys — no other hue anywhere
A 12-column grid (4 on mobile) drawn on every screen as permanent furniture
Totally flat: zero shadows, zero gradients, zero border-radius, zero cards
Cobalt restricted to the wordmark, section rules, and the single live email action
Numbered sections 01-04, mono spec-lists, framed plates with corner crop-marks
One animation only: the wordmark composes once on load

rules.name: The No-Hue-Beyond-Cobalt Rule
rules.body: The neutrals are one warm grey hue at stepped lightness; cobalt (#1B2BE0) is the only chromatic value in the system. No second accent, no tint, no gradient, no coloured state. If a surface needs emphasis and it is not the wordmark, a section rule, or the live action, it gets weight or a hairline — not colour.

rules.name: The Cobalt-Restraint Rule
rules.body: Cobalt appears on the wordmark, on load-bearing section rules, and on the one live mark (the email block) plus its direct echoes (active index chip, inline email/project links). It stays at roughly 20% of any viewport and never becomes a background field or an ornament. Its scarcity is what makes it read as 'this is the thing that matters.'

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Familjen Grotesk sets everything a person reads as language. Geist Mono sets everything a person reads as data — numbers, dates, dimensions, spec values, indices, the revision line. Mono is never used for prose and never for decoration; if it is not measurable, it is not mono.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Once Rule
rules.body: The display size belongs to the wordmark alone. Never set a section heading or a line of copy at display scale, and never render a second cobalt wordmark elsewhere.

rules.name: The Visible-Grid Rule
rules.body: The 12-column grid (4 on mobile) is permanent furniture. It is always rendered, never toggled, never decorative-only — every section aligns its blocks to it with col-span / col-start. New surfaces align to the same 12 columns inside .manual-shell.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Depth is lines, never shadow. If a surface needs to separate from its neighbour, give it a hairline, an ink rule, or grid alignment — never elevation.

dos: Do keep the whole surface on paper (#F5F2EA) and ink (#16150F) with muted/graphite for lesser text; introduce no hue other than cobalt (The No-Hue-Beyond-Cobalt Rule).
Do spend cobalt only on the wordmark, a whole section's 2px top rule, and the live email action plus its direct link echoes (The Cobalt-Restraint Rule).
Do render the 12-column grid on every screen and align every block to it with col-span / col-start inside .manual-shell (The Visible-Grid Rule).
Do set data — numbers, dates, dimensions, indices, the revision line — in Geist Mono, and everything readable in Familjen Grotesk (The Two-Voice Rule).
Do open a section with a 2px solid cobalt rule when it is whole, and a 1px dashed hairline-strong rule when its content is a curated empty state (broken).
Do frame images with PlateFrame and its corner ticks; use reserved (dashed border, 'riservato') for slots awaiting real content.
Do make hover and active states structural inversions (fill/text swap, outline to solid), with transition-colors only.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow, gradient, or border-radius anywhere — every surface is a hard-cornered flat rectangle, depth is lines (The Flat Rule).
Don't introduce cards, or any raised/lifted surface; separation is hairlines, ink rules, and grid alignment.
Don't set anything other than the wordmark at display scale, or place a second cobalt wordmark on the page (The Wordmark-Once Rule).
Don't use tracked uppercase micro-labels as decorative eyebrows over headlines; they are for document classification, spec keys, and captions only.
Don't animate anything except the one-time wordmark compose and CSS colour transitions on hover; respect prefers-reduced-motion (it drops the wordmark animation and smooth scroll).
Don't use mono for prose, or the sans for spec values — the family split is semantic.
Don't revive src/components/ui/* (shadcn/base-nova) or the .dark variant as design authority; the manual is light-only and those tokens are unused scaffolding.
